nodes.label: MapLibre GL (CDN, SRI-pinned)
nodes.rationale: MapLibre GL 3.6.2 CSS and JS are loaded from unpkg with SRI integrity hashes and crossorigin — the sole rendering library, no bundler.

nodes.label: Firebase Authentication (CDN)
nodes.rationale: firebase-app.js and firebase-auth.js are loaded as external CDN ES modules (gstatic, SRI-pinned) following the same convention as MapLibre; src/auth.js imports the exact same URLs so the browser module cache is reused rather than re-fetched. Identity layer only (Google/Microsoft/Facebook/email-password) — no Firestore.

nodes.label: Menu/Profile Merged Sheet
nodes.rationale: One physical .sheet with two panes (#menu-sheet-body/#profile-sheet-body) reached after 4 iterations: (1) coordinated two-sheet swap wobbled via a height reflow; (2) align-items:stretch removed the wobble but left dead whitespace below the shorter pane; (3) animating #mp-scroll/#mp-pane-track height directly broke scrolling and disabled slide transitions; (4) final design inserts #mp-height-wrap between #mp-scroll and #mp-pane-track so scroll-fit, active-pane height animation, and the slide transform never collide.
